audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads [Tryndamere, Skill, Mordekaiser x5] on both layers; packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere] at 48.13% over 1622 games. The page's own whys agree with the packet at every disputed row: whys[0] 'a farming standoff', whys[3] 'spin-kite your delayed Q... building fury and crits', whys[4] 'the edge is his to deny', whys[5] 'heal the chip faster than you can stack it', whys[6] 'outlast your flat late game'.
audit.why: Mordekaiser owns only the window before Fury and sustain exist — levels 2-3. From 4 onward Spinning Slash plus Mocking Shout kite the delayed Obliterate, and Undying Rage means even a perfect Realm is not automatically a kill.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2-3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 through 2+ items Tryndamere. Matched pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2-3 Q+W before his Fury bar fills, Lvl 6 Realm of Death, 1st crit item, Late full-crit spin-kite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage is described as 'Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then R' with no cooldown, and the page repeatedly tells you to 'engage on Undying Rage's cooldown' without ever giving it: 120/100/80s. It also never states the two facts that make it unbaitable — it costs no mana and no Fury, so there is no resource cost to pressure. Separately, Spinning Slash is a UNIT-TARGETED dash (Riot: 'slices toward a target unit'), which means minions are his stepping stones; nothing on the page says so. Bloodlust's heal is likewise never tied to anti-heal despite dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1] both being about anti-heal with placeholder text.
audit.why: Knowing his E needs a target changes the counterplay from 'don't chase' to 'deny him bodies to jump to'. Knowing R is free tells you not to plan around making him spend something.
audit.corrected: Undying Rage: 120/100/80s, no cost. Spinning Slash: 650-range unit-targeted dash on 12/11/10/9/8s. Mocking Shout: 850 range, 14s, cuts Attack Damage and slows only enemies with their backs turned. Bloodlust: 12s, consumes Fury to heal — Grievous Wounds caps it.

audit.why: The packet's suspectName on wants.foe[2] — 'Pop Undying Rage' — is a FALSE POSITIVE. Undying Rage is the correct Riot name; the checker matched the leading verb.

edits.before: Q start, but it's slow and telegraphed — Tryndamere dodges it on reaction at full HP. Last-hit, aim isolated Qs only when he commits to a CS.
edits.after: You are both weak at 1 — he has no Fury and no spin, you have only Q. It is a farming standoff, so last-hit clean and hold your cooldowns.

edits.before: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health. Short Q-auto trades now come out even or better because half the return damage gets absorbed.
edits.after: W banks a cut of the damage you deal and take as shield-health, and your Q+W land before his sustain does — so the short level-2 trade is yours clean.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Tryndamere must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Spinning Slash (12-8s) and Mocking Shout's slow let him spin-kite your delayed Q, and the longer you chase the more Fury and crit he banks.

edits.before: Realm of Death online — the 1v1 Tryndamere cannot decline. R steals 10% of his stats; take the duel whenever Undying Rage is down and the wave is shoved.
edits.after: Realm of Death is a 1v1 he cannot decline, but Undying Rage on 120/100/80s survives it at 1 HP — realm him only with burst left after the rage.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: His first crit item plus lifesteal lets him spin through your aura and heal the chip faster than you can stack it.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Tryndamere's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Full-crit spin-kite plus an Undying Rage he can pop at 1 HP outlast your flat late game — he survives every all-in, kites you out, and out-splits you.

edits.before: Level 3 onward the lane bends your way — the Realm at 6 is the cliff. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are yours and everything after that belongs to Tryndamere. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then R. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: 120/100/80s of unkillable at 1 HP, and it costs no mana or Fury — he can always afford it.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then R. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120/100/80s, and it costs nothing to cast. Force it out, then commit.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bloodlust converts his Fury into a heal on a 12s cooldown — cap it early.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is a 650-range dash on 12-8s and it targets a unit — he needs a minion or you to jump to, so deny him the stepping stones.

edits.before: Track Tryndamere's Undying Rage: Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then R. When it is down — R him — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and costs nothing — force it out, then R him with enough burst left to finish after it drops.

notes: Chart flipped to the packet: this is a losing matchup (48.13% over 1622 games) that the chart was rendering as a Mordekaiser stomp from level 3 on, while the page's own prose said the opposite from level 4 onward. The useful new facts are that Undying Rage costs nothing (so there is no resource to pressure, only the 120/100/80s cooldown) and that Spinning Slash is unit-targeted — he needs a body to jump to, which is real counterplay nobody had written down. UNVERIFIED, LEFT IN PLACE: several fields state Undying Rage lasts '5 seconds'. Riot's description in the kit file gives no duration and the kit's needsResearch is empty, so I neither repeated nor removed that number — my replacement text avoids asserting a duration. If the 5s figure is wrong it is currently on the page in spikes[1].text, content.mid and content.late. Recurring kit bug unchanged: Obliterate's grounding flag is unsupported by Riot's description — notable here because a grounding Q that stopped Spinning Slash would flip this matchup, so it must not be written until someone confirms it.
